source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Σίλος επίσκοπος Κορίνθου της Περσίας»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3092/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name; `silas-the-apostle` and `silas-of-sihastria-putnei` are another name on other days. The see is the page's own, oddly worded — «επίσκοπος Κορίνθου της Περσίας», bishop of Corinth in Persia — and is recorded in `office` exactly as the page has it, with no attempt here to say what place it means; no `locations` are proposed for the same reason. The page gives no year, so there is no `dates` object. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
